chapterFiles.title: Creation: the six days of forming + humankind made “in our image”; the seventh-day rest
The Garden of Eden: man formed from the dust + the four rivers and the two trees
The serpent's temptation and the fall + expulsion from Eden; the cherubim guard the tree of life
Cain and Abel: the first murder + the line of Cain and the birth of Seth
The book of the generations of Adam + Enoch who walked with God, and Methuselah
The sons of God and the daughters of men; the Nephilim + God resolves to flood the earth and commands the ark
The Flood begins: Noah's family and the animals enter the ark + the forty days of rain
The waters recede + the raven and the dove; Noah's altar
The covenant of the rainbow + Noah's drunkenness and the curse of Canaan
The Table of Nations: Shem, Ham, and Japheth + Nimrod the mighty hunter
The Tower of Babel: the confusion of tongues and the scattering + the line of Shem to Abram
The call of Abram: the promise of a great nation + the journey to Canaan and the sojourn in Egypt
Abram and Lot part ways + the land promised to Abram's offspring
The war of the kings; Lot rescued + Melchizedek's blessing
The covenant of the pieces: descendants as the stars + the four-hundred-year sojourn foretold
Hagar and the birth of Ishmael + the angel at the well
The covenant of circumcision + Isaac promised; Abram and Sarai renamed
The three visitors at Mamre: a son promised + Abraham pleads for Sodom
The destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah + Lot's escape and his wife turned to salt
Abraham and Abimelech: Sarah in Gerar
The birth of Isaac + Hagar and Ishmael sent away; the covenant at Beersheba
The binding of Isaac (the Akedah): the test and the ram in the thicket
The death of Sarah + Abraham buys the cave of Machpelah
A bride for Isaac: the servant's oath + Rebekah at the well
Abraham's death; the sons of Ishmael + Esau and Jacob born, and the birthright sold
Isaac and Abimelech: the reopened wells + the covenant at Beersheba
The stolen blessing: Jacob deceives Isaac + Esau's fury and Jacob's flight
Jacob's ladder at Bethel: the stairway to heaven + the vow
Jacob meets Rachel + serves Laban for Leah and Rachel
The children of Jacob + the speckled and spotted flocks
Jacob flees Laban + the household gods and the covenant at Mizpah
Jacob wrestles at Peniel + renamed Israel, on the eve of meeting Esau
The reconciliation of Jacob and Esau
Dinah and Shechem + the vengeance of Simeon and Levi
Jacob returns to Bethel + the deaths of Rachel (bearing Benjamin) and Isaac
The generations of Esau: the chiefs of Edom
Joseph's dreams + sold by his brothers into Egypt
Judah and Tamar
Joseph in Potiphar's house + falsely accused and imprisoned
Joseph interprets the dreams of the cupbearer and the baker
Pharaoh's dreams: seven years of plenty and famine + Joseph raised over Egypt
Joseph's brothers come for grain + Simeon held hostage
The second journey with Benjamin + Joseph's feast
The silver cup in Benjamin's sack + Judah's plea
Joseph reveals himself to his brothers + Pharaoh invites Jacob to Egypt
Jacob's family journeys to Egypt + the reunion with Joseph
Jacob settles in Goshen + Joseph's administration during the famine
Jacob blesses Ephraim and Manasseh
Jacob's blessings on the twelve sons + his death
Joseph forgives his brothers + his death and the oath concerning his bones

subtitles.en: First book of the Torah — creation, the flood, and the patriarchs

descriptions.en: The opening book of the Hebrew Bible, recounting the creation of the world, the early generations of humanity, the flood, and the lives of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Wheel of Heaven reads its account of the *Elohim* as the foundational text of the entire corpus.
